settings.provider: Model provider. Configure API keys securely in the Beacon sidebar; keys are not stored in Settings.
settings.deepseek.baseURL: API base URL (without /chat/completions). Use the endpoint for your account region.
settings.bailian.baseURL: API base URL (without /chat/completions). Use the endpoint for your account region.
settings.moonshot.baseURL: API base URL (without /chat/completions). Use the endpoint for your account region.
settings.ollama.baseURL: Ollama OpenAI-compatible base URL. Local HTTP or HTTPS is supported. Beacon does not install or start Ollama.
settings.model: Chat model ID. Fetch and select models from the Beacon sidebar, or enter an exact model ID here.
settings.modelParameters: Optional parameters saved separately for each provider, endpoint and model. Configure them in the Beacon sidebar.
permissions.none: No local file access. Existing conversation context remains available.
permissions.workspace: Read-only access to open workspace folders, excluding private files.
permissions.computer: Read-only access to local and network-share files, excluding private files.
permissions.description: File permission for future Beacon responses. Current responses keep their original permission. Read content is sent to the selected model service.
settings.modelCapabilities: Model capability overrides and thinking options saved for each provider, endpoint and model. Configure them in the Beacon sidebar.
settings.webEnabled: Allow the selected tool-capable model to search public information through Exa without a search API key. Changes during generation apply to the next response.
